theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mickle_rado_vitali_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : OuterMeasure (Eucl (m + 1))) (K : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (r : ℝ), IsClosed K → ψ K = 0 → (∀ z ∈ K, ∀ τ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r, ψ (ball z τ) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (τ ^ (m + 1))) → ∀ c₀ ∈ K, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 6 * t ≤ r → ψ (ball c₀ t) * (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) (ball 0 1) ≤ C * 6 ^ (m + 1) * (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) (ball c₀ (2 * t) \ K)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
